purpose: Improve plant identity evidence for the canonical CEA >=1 MW solar ownership buckets without forcing historical MWp/nameplate rows to equal a later CEA accounting boundary.

canonical_cea_boundary.derivation_note: State/private solar are the CEA March-2026 renewable ownership buckets after subtracting the independently reconciled wind ownership capacities. Central 92 MW is NTPC Kayamkulam floating solar.

firm_named_seed_from_ksebl_2021_22.rule: Only explicitly named rows with individual capacity >=1 MW are counted in this seed. The report's 'other small solar installations' and Soura portfolio are not decomposed into >=1 MW plants here.
